rows: National adult-resident public opinion and government evaluation
In-person interviews at respondents’ homes; full sampling and weighting details not extracted
Reported overall government evaluation: 49% positive, 49% negative. This is not party voting intention.
Single assessed government-evaluation wave; no validated same-question trend or national-to-municipal swing series.
Dated national opinion context only; no local government-change flag supported

Fieldwork ended 128 days before the snapshot. Primary report retrieval was blocked; indexed field dates and a named secondary interpretation support this record. Reported full-sample margin ±3.1 points is not a municipality-level margin. Proposed boundary reform and the 2019 boycott further limit local comparison.
